senses.gloss: vaibhāṣika, an adherent of the Buddhist school of this name: Mvy 〔5148〕.
Vaibhiḍiṅgī (loc. ˚gyāṃ) = Vebhaḍiṅga, see s.v. Veruḍiṅga, n. of the village of Nandīpāla Ghaṭīkāra: MSV 〔i.217.11〕. Tib. cited as Beḥi-bhi-ḍiṅ-ga-na.

vaibhūtika, (adj. or) subst. nt. (to Skt. vibhūti plus ika), splendor, magnificence: ˚kam (prob. subst.) Mvy 〔7480〕 = Tib. dbaṅ ḥbyor pa, lordly wealth; Chin. self-sufficient; independent; in Dharmas 〔109〕 prob. read aśeṣavaibhūtika-dhyāna for text ˚vaibhūṣita˚. In Pali vebhūtika seems to have only evil connotations; see PTSD.
